thread:
maria: Heads up — after last night's KMS rotation, a handful of SSO logins failed to complete. Error in auth logs: 'SAML assertion failed: nonce mismatch'. Happening for users provisioned via SCIM.

luca: Do we have exact timestamps / example user? Any pattern (IdP vendor, org)?

maria: example: alice@acme.com. Assertion snippet: 
<Assertion ...> ... <AuthnStatement>... nonce=abc123 ...</Assertion>
Error observed: nonce=abc123 expected=def456

elaine: Sounds like the verifier is using an old JWKS. Did the KMS rotation update the JWKS and the runtime reload?

maria: klog snippet:
2026-03-21T02:12:15Z ERROR saml-verifier: signature verification failed: KMS GetPublicKey 403 forbidden
2026-03-21T02:12:15Z WARN nonce_mismatch user=alice@acme.com nonce=abc123 expected=def456 request_id=req-9b7

idp-bot: IdP webhook: JWKS updated by okta-admin at 2026-03-21T01:59:10Z — kid=key-2026-03-21-01

luca: If GetPublicKey returned 403, likely the runtime's service principal lost permission after rotation. Which SA/role is the verifier using?

maria: runtime SA is redwood-saml-verifier@infra-prod. IAM shows kms:cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.getPublicKey allowed for redwood-saml-rotator but NOT for redwood-saml-verifier — explains the 403.

elaine: Two immediate options: grant verifier the kms.getPublicKey & kms.verify IAM permissions, or roll back to the previous key alias until we fix the post-rotate role-binding automation. Also ensure the verifier reloads JWKS when key changes.

maria: I'll patch IAM and trigger a rolling restart. Also noticed a related SCIM quirk: when we reprovision some users the SAML assertion drops the enterprise:role attribute — leads to RBAC drift. Provisioner logs show attribute removed during a reconcile when externalId was empty.

luca: That SCIM attribute removal could explain some users losing access even after signatures verify. Capture the scim-provisioner logs: it reports 'attribute removed: enterprise:role' and 'externalId blank -> skip mapping'.

maria: Planned remediation steps:
1) Add IAM binding: grant redwood-saml-verifier kms.getPublicKey & kms.asymmetricSign (as applicable)
2) Rolling restart of deployment/saml-verifier to reload JWKS and caches
3) Reprovision affected users via SCIM backfill (preserve enterprise:role)
4) Run audit query: label=post-rotate-kms-fix-2026-03-21 to confirm no further signature or nonce errors

elaine: +1. Add an automated step to the rotation playbook: update IAM bindings for verifier consumers and trigger a webhook to reload runtimes. Also add an audit event when JWKS changes.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by maria: rolling-restart deployment/saml-verifier (3 -> 0 -> 3) — started at 2026-03-21T03:05:00Z

maria: Patch applied. IAM binding added. Early checks: saml-verifier logs show successful KMS GetPublicKey and signature verification. alice@acme.com login succeeded. Will monitor for 24h and open a short postmortem with commands and the SCIM repro.

luca: Please include the exact gcloud commands and the minimal repro for the SCIM mapping bug in the postmortem. Also mark as P0 until RBAC backfill completes.

maria: Will do. Attaching commands & repro steps in the incident doc after monitoring. Thanks everyone.
